workflow_runs.display_title: Standards section: lead with what we create, not just what we adopt

head_commit.message:
Standards section: lead with what we create, not just what we adopt

Surfaces the concrete additions from the architecture (R-02/R-12/R-19):
- The memory protocol (no cross-vendor owner-controlled standard exists)
- Durable runs + consequence protocol (intent, unknown, reconcile)
- The sovereign world (private + shared domains, roles, quorum)
- The evidence spine (typed origins; why answered from the log)
Adopt/create split made explicit in the strip: MCP/A2A/SKILL.md and
CDP/Wayland/JSON-RPC adopted; missing protocols + sovereign layer created

workflow_runs.display_title: Correct claims: adopt MCP/A2A/SKILL.md; we build the enforcement layer

head_commit.message:
Correct claims: adopt MCP/A2A/SKILL.md; we build the enforcement layer

Addresses external review: 'nobody ships the rules between' was false —
MCP/A2A/ACP/ANP/AGNTCY are consortium-governed and production-deployed.

- Gap section reframed: protocols exist; what's missing is what runs them
  safely (containment, grants, health, restart — the enforcement layer)
- New Standards section: adopt MCP (tools), A2A (agents), SKILL.md (skills);
  create only what no standard covers (memory, loops, workspace, signing)
- Rules 01 wording: components connect via adopted standards
- Core routing job: components speak their own standards; core connects them
- 'Why now' final step: the enforcement layer becomes neutral
- Marquee, hero badge, lede, meta description aligned to the framing

workflow_runs.display_title: Align ResonantOS with resonantdao.com/whitepaper as DAO source of truth

head_commit.message:
Align ResonantOS with resonantdao.com/whitepaper as DAO source of truth

/about rewrite (Priority 3 from audit):
- H1 -> 'Where a human and a trusted AI meet.'
- Three pillars reframed: The Practice (Augmentatism) / The
  Operating Layer (ResonantOS with Augmentor) / The Stewardship
  Layer (ResonantDAO, custodian-led bootstrap)
- Founder note: 'The Resonant Augmentor' card now points to the
  ResonantDAO roadmap and reflects that AI Community Member
  registration is in Phase 1 (with a Human Community Member
  sponsor)
- 'Open Invitation' replaced with 'The Invitation' using the DAO
  whitepaper's contextual-governance framing (verified membership +
  earned contribution + sector reputation + tenure + human trust
  state) instead of the reductive 'not a popularity contest' line
- Drops the old 'community-governed system' claim (the DAO is
  custodian-led in Phase 1, not yet fully community-governed)

/whitepaper Priority 1 + 2:
- Title and meta: 'Current DAO Path' -> 'A Philosophical Foundation'
- Hero subtitle points readers to resonantdao.com/whitepaper
- Abstract: source-of-truth note + updated link
- New 'What this document is' callout right after the hero
- Chapter 2 (Oracle/Logician): legacy note at the top
- Chapter 5: 'Resonant Commons Symbiotic License (RC-SL)' ->
  'Symbiotic Licence' throughout; tithe mechanics and $1M
  small-company threshold removed; pointers to resonantdao.com/
  whitepaper and /symbiotic-license
- Glossary: legacy note flagging the old internal-architecture terms

All edits are text-only. No UI/UX, scripts, or styles modified.
resonantdao.com itself was not touched.

workflow_runs.name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
workflow_runs.display_title: Point all ResonantDAO references to resonantdao.com

head_commit.message:
Point all ResonantDAO references to resonantdao.com

- /about: 3 textual 'ResonantDAO' mentions are now clickable links
  to https://resonantdao.com/ (external, new tab). Meta description
  refreshed from 'DAO-first architecture' to 'stewardship layer'
  framing to match the new narrative.
- /whitepaper: 1 textual 'ResonantDAO' mention in the Abstract is
  now a clickable link to https://resonantdao.com/.
- /dao: page replaced with a static meta-refresh redirect to
  https://resonantdao.com/ (status 301, canonical link set, noindex).
  Original 573-line Resonant Economy / Karma-to-Speculative content
  preserved in git history (commits <= 75e0921).

Implementation note: the redirect is generated at build time via
Astro.redirect() and produces a static HTML page with
<meta http-equiv='refresh' content='0;url=...'> plus a
<link rel='canonical'> to the new URL. Works on any static host,
including GitHub Pages (which is the actual deploy target).

Reframe trust model: configurable autonomy with smart-contract guardrails

    (now 'Trust Boundaries: You Set the Loop')
  - 'Not for' list (rejects one-size-fits-all trust policy, not
    autonomous action per se)
